title: U.S. Tariffs Could Price Canadian Firms Out of U.S. and Threaten Thousands of Jobs
summary: The 50 percent tariffs President Trump imposed on Canadian exports to the United States will make it impossible for many Canadian companies to continue to sell to the U.S. market, economists say.

title: How U.S.-Canada Tariff Negotiations Turned Into an All-Out Trade War
summary: Detailed accounts of the final hours of the negotiations show that, while the United States offered Canada what it said was the best deal of any country, what Canada had to give up in exchange was seen as unthinkable.

title: What We Know About Australia’s Bird Flu, Which Has Crossed Over to Mammals
summary: Australia confirmed its first case of H5N1 in June in migratory seabirds. Since then, the virus has spread rapidly, straining government responses.

title: Chinese Artist Sentenced to Three Years in Prison for Mao Sculptures
summary: Gao Zhen, part of a brotherly duo famous for satirical artworks, was convicted of slandering one of China’s heroes after a secret one-day trial.

title: Australia Bans Generative A.I. From Official Music Charts
summary: Under new rules, recordings developed using generative A.I. will only be allowed if they are “substantially human-made,” the peak body says.
